name: DeepSeek Harness for Win v1.1.2

itemsEn: Unified the Update Hub modal to a stable 620 × 660 px base size across Release Notes and About.
Removed modal width/height transitions and keyword-size interpolation so tab changes no longer move the close button, footer actions, or visual focus.
Kept narrow-window sizing responsive through shared modal variables and prevented header titles and tabs from wrapping unexpectedly.
itemsZh: 将更新日志和关于统一到稳定的 620 × 660 px 弹窗基础尺寸。
移除弹窗宽高过渡动画和关键字尺寸插值，切换 Tab 时关闭按钮、底部操作栏和视觉焦点不再发生跳跃位移。
使用共享弹窗变量保持窄窗口自适应，并避免头部标题和 Tab 意外换行。

itemsEn: Synchronized the desktop shell locale with the Harness setting for consistent menus, release notes, and About content.
Hardened the updater launcher and post-update loopback health probe with safer process handling and reliable exit-status reporting.
Kept strict portable-runtime source consistency checks, release manifests, archive layout validation, and generated SHA-256 checksums in the release gate.
itemsZh: 桌面外壳与 Harness 设置同步语言，使菜单、更新日志和关于页面保持一致。
加固更新器启动器与更新后回环健康探针，改善进程处理安全性并可靠传递退出状态。
发布门禁继续执行便携运行时源码一致性、发布清单、压缩包布局和 SHA-256 校验和校验。

body:
## Fixes / 修复

- Unified the Update Hub modal to a stable 620 × 660 px base size across Release Notes and About. / 将更新日志和关于统一到稳定的 620 × 660 px 弹窗基础尺寸。
- Removed modal width/height transitions and keyword-size interpolation so tab changes no longer move the close button, footer actions, or visual focus. / 移除弹窗宽高过渡动画和关键字尺寸插值，切换 Tab 时关闭按钮、底部操作栏和视觉焦点不再发生跳跃位移。
- Kept narrow-window sizing responsive through shared modal variables and prevented header titles and tabs from wrapping unexpectedly. / 使用共享弹窗变量保持窄窗口自适应，并避免头部标题和 Tab 意外换行。

## Improvements / 优化提升

- Synchronized the desktop shell locale with the Harness setting for consistent menus, release notes, and About content. / 桌面外壳与 Harness 设置同步语言，使菜单、更新日志和关于页面保持一致。
- Hardened the updater launcher and post-update loopback health probe with safer process handling and reliable exit-status reporting. / 加固更新器启动器与更新后回环健康探针，改善进程处理安全性并可靠传递退出状态。
- Kept strict portable-runtime source consistency checks, release manifests, archive layout validation, and generated SHA-256 checksums in the release gate. / 发布门禁继续执行便携运行时源码一致性、发布清单、压缩包布局和 SHA-256 校验和校验。
